{{Quote|You still holding a grudge?''"<br />"''You still breathing?|[[Meetra Surik]] and Kex|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Kex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who worked as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the [[Mandalorian Outpost (Dxun)|Mandalorian camp]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Prior to joining the camp, he was found by [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] while working as muscle for [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Though he sold and bought items to and from [[Meetra Surik]], he had an extreme dislike toward the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], partly because Surik was a Jedi and an outsider and partially because he had lost to Surik in the [[Battle Circle]]. He was part of Mandalore's strike force during the [[Battle of Telos IV]], where [[Darth Nihilus]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']] destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
As Kex challenged Surik, the player is allowed to choose the terms for engagement: either unarmed, swords, or use of their Force powers and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
